MUNTJAC DEER
CR 1/4

This small deer is the size of a dog, it lifts its small, shortantlered head and watches you warily.

XP 100
N Small animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +0 (1d4-1) or bite +0 (1d3-1)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 17, Con 10, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 6
Base Attack +0; CMB +0; CMD 13 (17 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge (B), Mobility (B), Run
Skills Acrobatics +3 (+7 while jumping), Perception +10, Stealth +7 (+11 in forests), Swim +3; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+8 in forests), +4 Swim

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a muntjac deer familiar gains a +2 bonus on Initiative checks.

ECOLOGY

Environment forests
Organization solitary or herd (2 – 20)
Treasure none

These small deer have short, curved antlers that look like ribs which has given them the nickname ‘rib-faced deer’. Another moniker given to them is ‘barking deer’ for their odd bark-like sound they make when provoked. These small deer also have enlarged canines that they use to defend themselves or to fight for mates.

Males will tend to use their antlers to push a rival off-balance before attempting to use their canine teeth.
